title: Brand
description: A versioned brand-identity record for Rough Draft Builders Club (RDBC) — voice, tone, and visual-system definitions as they evolve over time. This is a schema *contract* only (architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §8); no runtime enforces it yet (src/ does not exist before Phase 16). Deliberately structural: the project's actual brand content (voice guidelines, visual-system specification) does not exist yet — Phase 07 ("Brand and Creative System") authors real instances against this shape. No field in this schema or its fixtures may contain a real or realistic-looking RDBC brand name, tagline, or visual-identity value (DATA_RETENTION_POLICY.md §7, extended to schema documents project-wide). See architecture/STATE_MACHINE.md for this entity's documented lifecycle transitions between `status` values.

id.description: Server-assigned identity. Never client-supplied, never reused. Shared envelope field, architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

schema_version.description: The exact semver version of brand.schema.json this record was written against. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1, §3.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen deduplication key; a create request whose idempotency_key matches an existing brand record returns the existing record rather than creating a duplicate. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1, §4.

status.description: This brand-identity version's own lifecycle status. Enum values and reasoning are this schema's own design choice (Data Architect, Phase 04); transitions between them are documented separately in architecture/STATE_MACHINE.md, which cites this exact enum. DRAFT: this version of the brand identity is being authored or revised and is not the version currently in use. ACTIVE: this is the current, in-use version of the brand identity — at most one brand record is expected to be ACTIVE at a time, though this schema does not itself enforce that (no runtime exists; a future phase's deterministic code would enforce single-ACTIVE, per Architecture Rule 3 / D-003). SUPERSEDED: this version was once ACTIVE and has been replaced by a newer version; retained for history, consistent with this project's general append/supersede rule (D-001) rather than deletion or in-place rewriting.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter, starts at 1. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1. Distinct from the brand-identity's own conceptual "version number" a human might refer to informally (e.g. "brand v2") — this field is the record's own concurrency counter, not a marketing-facing version label.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339. Set once, never mutated. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339. Set on every accepted mutation; must be >= created_at. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

created_by_role.description: Which role created this record — a closed role token from policy/action_registry.json's `roles` array, never a person's name or an invented role. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

title.description: A short structural label identifying what this brand-identity version defines, e.g. a placeholder such as "voice and visual system, version N" in a fixture — never a real RDBC brand asset name.

summary.description: A structural description of what this brand-identity version covers (e.g. that it defines voice, tone, or a visual-system specification) without instantiating any actual brand content — that content is Phase 07's deliverable, not this phase's.
